description: Individually inspected source pages and figures with adapted mathematical briefs. Requested collection positions 56–75 were absent. No authenticated sitting, official key, paper order or exam-board licence is asserted.

records.adapted_prompt: In triangle PQR, S lies on QR with QS=11 cm and SR=9 cm. If PS=13 cm and PS is perpendicular to QR, what is the area of triangle PQR?

source_figure.transcription: S lies on QR, QS=11 cm, SR=9 cm, PS=13 cm, and PS is perpendicular to QR.

records.source_repair: The publisher repeated one incorrect option; the adapted practice uses four distinct choices. The independently solved answer is unchanged.

records.adapted_prompt: Convert 54 in base ten to a numeral in base four.
records.source_repair: The publisher appended an incompatible decimal-place instruction to a base-four conversion. The adapted prompt asks only for the exact base-four numeral.

records.adapted_prompt: Which expression equals the positive fourth root of 0.16?
records.source_repair: The publisher called a fractional-power-of-ten expression standard form. The adapted prompt asks for an equivalent expression instead.

records.adapted_prompt: A pie chart represents 16 doctors, 8 engineers, 24 lawyers, 21 information technologists and 27 teachers. What central angle represents the doctors?

source_figure.transcription: Pie-chart counts: 16 doctors, 8 engineers, 24 lawyers, 21 information technologists, 27 teachers.

records.adapted_prompt: In a three-set Venn diagram, only the part of Q outside both P and R is shaded. Which expression describes the shaded region?

source_figure.transcription: Only the part of circle Q outside both P and R is shaded.
